title: field_ops.order.failed v1
description: Emitted when a field order moves to status='failed': the technician could not do the work (customer absent, refused, no access...) and recorded why (ADR-37 §18.3). The attempt is also written as a visit with outcome 'failed' in the same transaction. A failed order can be re-assigned (a new attempt, attempt_count + 1, emitted as field_ops.order.assigned with previous_status 'failed') or cancelled. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex Workers.EventPublisher, relaying the [:alebrije_field_ops, :order, :failed] telemetry event that Orders.emit_status_event/2 fires after the transition commits. The envelope is built by AlebrijeCommon.Events.Publish.build_envelope/3, so every field below lives under `data` (telemetry metadata stringified, measurements prefixed with m_). The technician's free-text notes are NOT published: they stay on the order and its visit.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the order (ADR-25). Repeated inside data because the producer copies the telemetry metadata verbatim.

kind.description: Order kind. Configurable per tenant and context (ADR-127, KindConfigCache), so it is NOT a closed enum.

status.description: New status, always 'failed' for this event.

failure_reason.description: Code from the failure catalog of the order's kind definition (ADR-37 §18.3); without a definition, the platform default catalog: customer_absent, refused, wrong_address, no_access, rescheduled_by_customer, other. Tenants define their own codes, so consumers must tolerate any snake_case value.

attempt_count.description: Which attempt failed (1 = the first visit). A retry re-assigns the order and adds 1.

kind_definition_id.description: Kind definition version the order was created under (its snapshot). Null when the kind had no definition.

share_token.description: Public tracking token. It is a credential for the tracking page: consumers must not log it.

tracking_link.description: Public tracking URL built from share_token.

completed_at.description: Always null for this event (the order was not completed).
